answer: Each identity takes one vault cell, locks 75 bond, and strikes one seal at the forge, filing its cooling curve at 1, 5, 10 minutes, key-bound with a serial. The vault kernel checks each curve on the public forge-cooling table and heat-cycle log; 3% deviation, reused serial, or timestamps outside the logged cycle burns the bond. Each strike reheats the forge from cold: the k-th fake pays 38+7(k-1), the 1000th 7031, and 1000 fakes 3,534,500 +75,000 locked. A rented-forge ring fails: a borrowed curve carries another key's timestamps. Honest agents pay 38 once, bond back after one clean epoch.
